title: Herdr-skill+ Quiz
description: Reference interchange schema for quiz / knowledge-check items rendered through herdr-lab §7 (ask_user_question gate). Importers (PDF chapters via docs-ingest+pymupdf4llm, literature paper Q&A, or hand-authored) emit this shape so §7 can render each item via the same per-item ask_user_question loop. §7 does not require this schema to be used; agent-authored inline items skip it. Schema v1 is intentionally minimal - one JSON document per quiz, one item per document line. Promoting schema-specific fields to required makes importers harder, not easier.

schema.description: Schema URI / version. Bump the suffix when adding a breaking field. v1 = ask_user_question primitives only (2026-09-15).

title.description: Short human-readable title for the quiz; surfaces as the first chat message after §7 setup.

lesson_id.description: Optional opaque id for cross-referencing with the §6 tutorial-mode lesson plan (e.g. 'ch3-sam-flags'). Not consumed by §7; supplied for replays / score-tracking.

source.description: Provenance of the items - which PDF, which chapter, which NotebookLM notebook. Optional; recommended for source-derived items, omitted for hand-authored ones.

extracted_by.description: Tool chain that produced this quiz (e.g. 'docs-ingest+pymupdf4llm+llm-from-snippet'). For audit only.

items.description: 5-6 items recommended. §7 enforces one ask_user_question call per item; larger quizzes stress the per-turn context budget.

q.description: Question text rendered as ask_user_question.question (must end with '?' after author copy-edits).

options.description: Required for mcq / multi / preview (2-4 options); optional / forbidden for short and task. When omitted for short, the host appends its 'Type something.' row at runtime. Rendered in declaration order by §7 - vary the correct option's position across items so students cannot pattern-match it (see SKILL.md §7 anti-patterns).

answer_key.description: Reference answer for 'short' items. Free text the student types into the 'Type something.' row is graded against this. Accept obvious synonyms during grading (§7 anti-pattern: don't strict-match).

task_id.description: Opaque id linking a 'task' item to its §6 sibling lesson. Used by replay / score-tracking, not by §7 itself.

instruction.description: Plain-language instruction the agent issues in chat for a 'task' item (e.g. 'run samtools flagstat aln.bam').

gates.description: For 'task' items: the two-option labels for the I-did-it / Something-went-wrong gate. Defaults to §6's canonical labels if absent.

provenance.description: Per-item source pointer (page, snippet, generated-by). Same structure as the top-level 'source.provenance' if needed.

description.description: ask_user_question option description (what choosing this means).

preview.description: Markdown rendered side-by-side (≥100 cols). single-select (mcq/preview) only - ask_user_question forbids preview on multi-select.

correct.description: Grader flag. mcq: exactly one option must be correct. multi: zero or more; grade by set-equality. preview: exactly one. short/task: omit (use answer_key or task_id).
